workflow: Existing CLI batch conversion: trusted Markdown to complete offline UTF-8 HTML pages

source.execution: python -m markdown from the source checkout; no pip installation of Markdown

entry_environment_failure.cause: Initial entry selected an interpreter without the Agent requests dependency.
entry_environment_failure.repair: Reuse configure_clients.choose_python to select the prepared Agent environment; document the existing Agent setup prerequisite.

same_job_recovery.fault: Explicit command selected one missing task input and returned exit code 1; original outputs were preserved.
same_job_recovery.repair: rw_replan supplied only the missing synthetic input, ran only that document, and retained six required checks with preserved freshness.

verification_tool_correction.cause: One private final assertion compared an unencoded filename with a URL-encoded href.
verification_tool_correction.repair: Read-only correction using saved real command result (converted=1 and the exact output filename), plus independent artifact review.

acceptance_scope: Table values and fenced code, including literal.md
Space-containing filenames and local links with query/fragment
Original input bytes preserved; UTF-8 BOM supported
Real missing-input failure and same-job affected-only recovery
measurement_scope: Reported seconds are the core execution phase, not complete user wall time or model performance. Command counts are executions, not retry counts or all subprocesses.
data_and_side_effects: Synthetic input only; official GitHub source acquisition; local owned job/output/log directories; no credentials, global installation, persistent service or external posting.
